title: Water and Reflection as Memory Boundary
observed_structure: A reflective or liquid surface separates present action from unstable memory, identity, or perception.
Distortion, duration, and sound make the reflected state diverge from the physical source.
misuse_risks: slow cinema imitation without causal function
reflection used as a fixed identity symbol
transferable_structure: Use a reflective or liquid boundary whose distortion and duration alter how present action relates to memory or identity.
non_transferable_surface: Do not copy specific Russian locations, Orthodox imagery, shot durations, or compositions from Tarkovsky's films.
